item.title: Augusta man gets 105 years for multiple entering auto charges
item.description: An Augusta man has been sentenced to 105 years in prison for numerous car break-ins in Columbia County. The post Augusta man gets 105 years for multiple entering auto charges appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Augusta inmate among three killed in deadly prison riot in Davisboro
item.description: An inmate with a lengthy and violent criminal history of crime in Augusta was among three men killed during a disturbance at Washington State Prison on Sunday. The post Augusta inmate among three killed in deadly prison riot in Davisboro appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Brooks Koepka returns to PGA Tour under stiff financial penalty just 5 weeks after leaving LIV
item.description: Brooks Koepka is returning to the PGA Tour just five weeks after bolting from LIV Golf, agreeing to a one-time program for elite players that comes with a financial penalty that could rank among the largest in sports. The post Brooks Koepka returns to PGA Tour under stiff financial penalty just 5 weeks after leaving LIV appeared first on The Augusta Press.
